content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-hosted, platform-independent system for selling digital products. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a combination of open tools and protocols that you own and control. The core difference? You’re not renting space on someone else’s platform. You’re building on your own land. This matters because platforms like Gumroad and Payhip rely on Stripe or PayPal for payments. When those gateways block your country, your business stops. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by using on-chain crypto payments. No Stripe. No PayPal. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The Edge Commerce Stack, for example, uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. You deploy it once, and it’s yours. No monthly fees. No shutdown risk. Full data ownership. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not a workaround, but a permanent structural alternative.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular. Each component serves a specific function. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. It’s free, fast, and globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic—processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering file delivery. Supabase stores order data in a PostgreSQL database, accessible via SQL or REST API. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. File delivery happens via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. The customer pays in crypto, the system verifies the payment, logs the order, and delivers the product—all without touching a third-party platform. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration to ensure order confirmations land in inboxes, not spam folders. End-to-end testing ensures every component works seamlessly. You deploy this stack in 48 hours. After that, it runs itself. No maintenance required. No platform dependencies. Just sovereign infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, or similar regions, this is for you. It’s also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty—those who want to own their stack, not rent it. The Edge Commerce Stack is priced at $197. That’s not a subscription. It’s a one-time fee for a fully deployed, end-to-end tested system. You get lifetime access. No hidden costs. No upsells. The stack is designed to handle up to 5 products out of the box, with room to scale. It’s not built for startups or side hustles. It’s built for creators who treat their digital products as a business—and want infrastructure that reflects that.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes platform dependencies, giving you full control over your digital product sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages provides static hosting for your storefront. It’s free, fast, and integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic—processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering file delivery. Supabase provides a PostgreSQL database for order storage, accessible via SQL or REST API. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. File delivery happens via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive—both free and reliable. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration to ensure order confirmations land in inboxes. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. The stack is deployed via GitHub or directly to Cloudflare. Once deployed, it requires no maintenance. No platform dependencies. No single points of failure. Just sovereign infrastructure.

Start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack. It’s $197, deployed in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to order. Provide your product details, and COREMERCH will deploy the stack, load up to 5 products, and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery. After deployment, you own the stack. COREMERCH has no access. No subscriptions. No hidden fees. To scale, follow the Sovereign Blueprint or Complete Builder Kit. These include full source code, scaling playbooks, and integration guides. The Edge Commerce Stack is built to handle growth. Add more products, increase traffic, or expand to new regions—the infrastructure supports it. This isn’t a temporary solution. It’s a permanent structural alternative. Built for creators who want to own their commerce infrastructure, not rent it.

Frequently Asked Questions
Why can’t I use Stripe or PayPal in my country?

Stripe and PayPal operate on a compliance-first model, blocking countries based on perceived risk, not actual fraud. This excludes regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, even if the creator is legitimate.
What is NOWPayments and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a crypto payment gateway supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies. It charges a 0.5% fee, requires no KYC, and fires a webhook the moment a payment confirms on-chain, enabling automatic product delivery.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this stack?

The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours. After deployment, basic technical knowledge is helpful for maintenance, but the stack is designed to run itself with no ongoing intervention.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is built to handle growth. You can add more products, increase traffic, or expand to new regions. The Sovereign Blueprint and Complete Builder Kit include scaling playbooks for advanced use cases.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a decentralized crypto payment gateway with high uptime. If it does go down, the stack can be reconfigured to use an alternative gateway. The infrastructure is modular and platform-independent.
